s:
A company has an application that uses an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL DB cluster for the application's database. The DB cluster contains one small primary instance and three larger replica

instances. The application runs on an AWS Lambda function. The application makes many short-lived connections to the database's replica instances to perform read-only operations. During periods of high traffic, the application becomes unreliable and the database reports that too many connections are being established. The frequency of high-traffic periods is unpredictable. Which solution will improve the reliability of the application?
o: Use Amazon RDS Proxy to create a proxy for the DB cluster. Configure a read-only endpoint for the proxy. Update the Lambda function to connect to the proxy endpoint.
Increase the max_connections setting on the DB cluster's parameter group. Reboot all the instances in the DB cluster. Update the Lambda function to connect to the DB cluster endpoint.

Configure instance scaling for the DB cluster to occur when the DatabaseConnections metric is close to the max _ connections setting. Update the Lambda function to connect to the Aurora reader endpoint.
Use Amazon RDS Proxy to create a proxy for the DB cluster. Configure a read-only endpoint for the Aurora Data API on the proxy. Update the Lambda function to connect to the proxy endpoint.

w.y: Many short-lived Lambda connections exhaust max_connections on unpredictable spikes. Amazon RDS Proxy pools and reuses connections. A proxy read-only endpoint sends traffic to the Aurora Replicas, which is where the read-only work belongs, so the database sees a small, stable number of connections.

o.A: Correct: RDS Proxy multiplexes Lambda connections, and its read-only endpoint routes them to the Aurora Replicas.
o.B: Raising max_connections only moves the ceiling, consumes memory, needs reboots, and the cluster (writer) endpoint sends reads to the small primary.
o.C: Aurora replica auto scaling reacts too slowly for sudden spikes and does not pool connections; each Lambda invocation still opens its own connection.
o.D: RDS Proxy has no Data API endpoint option; the Data API is a separate HTTP interface, not a proxy endpoint type.

s: Working with Amazon RDS Proxy endpoints
Use Amazon RDS Proxy with read-only endpoints
